painPoints.title: Manual order processing and tracking
painPoints.description: Inefficient management of customer orders, fulfillment, and shipment status updates.

painPoints.title: Disconnected inventory and sales data
painPoints.description: Lack of integration between inventory management and sales channels leading to stock discrepancies.

painPoints.title: Tedious accounts receivable and payable
painPoints.description: Time-consuming manual invoicing, payments, and reconciliation processes.

painPoints.title: Inaccurate financial and operational reporting
painPoints.description: Difficulty in generating reliable and timely reports for decision-making.

painPoints.title: Compliance challenges with regulations and audits
painPoints.description: Struggles to maintain proper documentation and meet industry-specific compliance requirements.

painPoints.title: Inefficient vendor and supplier management
painPoints.description: Lack of centralized vendor information and difficulty in coordinating with multiple suppliers.

painPoints.title: Inaccurate inventory tracking and forecasting
painPoints.description: Challenges in maintaining real-time inventory visibility and planning future purchasing needs.

painPoints.title: Errors in order fulfillment and shipping
painPoints.description: Mistakes in processing customer orders, leading to incorrect shipments and customer dissatisfaction.

painPoints.title: Lack of customer relationship management (CRM)
painPoints.description: Difficulty in maintaining and leveraging customer data to enhance sales and service.

painPoints.title: Inefficient employee onboarding and training
painPoints.description: Time-consuming processes for onboarding new employees and providing necessary training.
